correctness.rationale: From the LCF edges independently reconstruct a simple cubic 12-vertex graph with 18 edges; exhaustively enumerate all 2^18-1 nonempty subsets, test matching validity, obtain 1,025 matching simplices with f=(18,117,333,397,152,8). Deterministic pivot matching yields 502 unique face-coface pairs and precisely one 0-critical cell plus twenty 3-critical cells; orient all 3,629 nonempty Hasse incidences matching upwards and others downwards; independent Kahn topological sort visits all 1,025 nodes, so acyclic. Finite discrete Morse gives CW of one 0-cell and twenty 3-cells, all attaching maps constant, hence wedge of twenty 3-spheres integrally, not merely mod-two homology.
